name: garde-prod
description: Production guard: flags every command that touches production or is risky (force push, secrets, rm -rf…), checks for a fresh database backup before a production write (can refuse without one), and keeps refused commands ready to run yourself with !. French or English.

backupPattern.title: Backup command
backupPattern.description: Regular expression matching your own database backup command, on top of pg_dump, mysqldump, mongodump

backupMaxAgeMinutes.title: Backup valid for (minutes)
backupMaxAgeMinutes.description: Past this age, a production database write is flagged “no backup”

requireBackup.title: Require a backup
requireBackup.description: Refuse a production database write without a recent backup
